name: 影分身之术
description: 选择5格内1格：召唤1个影分身，或传送到目标格并在原地留下1个影分身。影分身受到1次伤害后消散，不能行动，被击杀时不会提供充能。

options.label: 传送至目标格，原地留下分身

code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var battle = context.battle; var option = selectOption({ title: '选择影分身方式', options: [{ label: '在目标格召唤分身', value: 'summon' }, { label: '传送至目标格，原地留下分身', value: 'teleport' }] }); if (option === null || option === undefined || option.needsOptionSelection) return option; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 5, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; var dist = Math.abs(pos.x - caster.x) + Math.abs(pos.y - caster.y); if (dist > 5) return { success: false, message: '影分身之术只能选择5格内的位置' }; var targetTile = battle.map && battle.map.tiles && battle.map.tiles.find(function(t) { return t.x === pos.x && t.y === pos.y; }); if (!targetTile || !targetTile.props || !targetTile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '目标格不可行走' }; var cloneX, cloneY; if (option === 'summon') { var pieceAtPos = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.x === pos.x && p.y === pos.y && p.currentHp > 0; }); if (pieceAtPos) return { success: false, message: '目标格已被占用' }; cloneX = pos.x; cloneY = pos.y; } else { var pieceAtPos2 = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.x === pos.x && p.y === pos.y && p.currentHp > 0 && p.instanceId !== caster.instanceId; }); if (pieceAtPos2) return { success: false, message: '目标格已被占用' }; cloneX = caster.x; cloneY = caster.y; caster.x = pos.x; caster.y = pos.y; } context.summonQueue.push({ summons: [{ x: cloneX, y: cloneY, variant: option }], sourceId: caster.instanceId }); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '使用了影分身之术' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '选择5格内1格：召唤1个影分身，或传送到目标格并在原地留下1个影分身。影分身受到1次伤害后消散，不能行动，被击杀时不会提供充能。', expectedValues: {} }; }
